chapter: Union, New Orleans and King Oliver
title: Second reel: getting a union card through Manuel Mineta
summary: After the reel change, Reason tells how Barnes took him to the union secretary, who loaned him the dollar for a card.

We'll check that out. Yeah. We talked about Manuel Mineta. He was Secretary of the Union, you said.

Yes. He was Secretary of the Union. He lived over in Algae. And Paul Barnes carried me over to his house. Mm-hmm. Made me acquainted with him. And he said he would like to get me into the Union. And during that time, only the New Orleans musicians had a Union card. You could go all over to Louisiana, you wouldn't find any musicians with a Union card. And Paul D. Barnes' whole band, we didn't have a Union card. And so, he took me over to Manuel Mineta's home. And I didn't have the dollar. So, he loaned me the dollar and wrote me up. And he said, well now, every week you bring me a quarter. Mineta said that? Yeah. So, you pay me a quarter, so you pay me my dollar back. Mm-hmm.
